item.title: Phulpati Dashain Messages: Nepal PM and President urge unity; Shah recalls Bhotekoshi floods
item.description: Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah and President Ramchandra Paudel share heartfelt festive wishes for Bada Dashain, underlining family cohesion and social harmony. Paudel notes the festival’s significance in fostering goodwill and cultural richness across Nepal’s communities, urging citizens to cherish their traditions and unite in celebration despite struggles. item.title: Violent Albania Protests Escalate: Student movement confronts Edi Rama; hundreds detained, dozens injured
item.description: In Tirana, a large assembly of students is rallying for Prime Minister Edi Rama's resignation, citing rampant corruption. Tensions escalated into violent confrontations with riot police, resulting in several injuries. The protests highlight widespread dissatisfaction in Albania linked to job scarcity and corruption, aligning with similar movements across Europe regarding public services and living expenses. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
